name: simplify
description: Simplify code for clarity without changing behavior, using code-simplification skill

steps.prompt: Analyze the code at: {{input}}. Identify complexity: deep nesting, over-abstraction, redundancy, unclear naming, dead code
Simplify one pattern at a time. After each change: verify tests still pass, verify behavior unchanged
Check for deprecation opportunities: remove commented-out code, remove always-on feature flags, remove unreachable branches
Final review: is the code clearer? Is there less code? Can a new team member understand it?
